summary.headline: Astrological Judgments and Sowing Terms
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging outcomes from a star’s angularity, eastern or western position, lots, trine lord, zodiac sign, witnesses, and sect. A new section gives three sowing terms—250, 273, and 288 days—linked to the Moon’s position and zodiac signs, beginning with Cancer ascending and Capricorn setting.
